style: Flat 2D illustration, a wide double-page spread from a children's picture book. {subject} No black outlines: shapes are flat colour fills only, every colour with a slightly darker flat shade for simple two-tone shading. Bright saturated colours, clean simple shapes, lots of calm open space. No text, no letters, no numbers.

items.bg: A flat side view of a cosy warm family living room like a stage set seen straight from the front with no perspective, with NO animals and NO people: a pale yellow wall with a big window showing blue sky in the middle, a soft red sofa on the left, a low wooden table on the right with nothing on top, a potted plant in a corner, and a wide light wooden floor with a big round blue rug across the bottom third of the picture.
